adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed first via `(await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which can trigger DB queries before the cheaper in-memory checks `isOrganizer` and `isAttendee` are computed. Also, for non-team bookings where `booking.eventType?.teamId` is null/undefined, the code passes `0` into `isTeamAdmin` (and potentially `isTeamOwner`), causing unnecessary lookups. This is a concrete performance/ordering concern shown in the diff, not a functional defect.
